thread:
maria.s: Heads up: partner ingestion team dumped a GCS log archive that contains KMS ciphertext URIs referencing `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner-keys/cryptoKeys/acme-wrap`. Not plaintext but we should treat as a potential exposure.
aj: Can you paste an example ciphertext path? We need to run decrypt/audit checks.
maria.s: Example log line: `gcs://partner-logs/2026-03-20/ingest-20260320.log: "wrapped_key": "acme-wrap/cryptoKeyVersions/1", "ciphertext": "..."` — found ~42 hits across 2026-03-19..21.
samir: Inventory first. I'll run a fast GCS grep to list objects and then run KMS audit logs for Decrypt/AsymmetricDecrypt calls filtered to that key.
len: Also check if we have any Vault transit mounts pointing at that key (possible partner shared integration). If Vault did unwrap, plaintext could be in our storages.
sec-oncall: Assume compromise for now. Immediate actions: 1) inventory blobs referencing the key; 2) query KMS Data Access logs for decrypts and list principal emails + timestamps; 3) freeze any downstream datasets until lineage confirmed; 4) add temporary RBAC restrictions on the key.
aj: Gcloud helper for last decrypts: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:Decrypt OR protoPayload.methodName:AsymmetricDecrypt' --project=redwood-prod --freshness=30d --format='table(timestamp, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.request.name)'`
samir: Ran the query: 8 decrypt calls, principals include partner-ingest@partner-prod (6) and redwood-analytics-sa@redwood-prod (2) on 2026-03-20 03:14Z and 2026-03-21 10:05Z.
len: If analytics used plaintext, ask analytics to snapshot the dataset and mark for IR. Who owns analytics? rosa is owner.
maria.s: Pinged rosa and partner SRE. Partner confirms they rotated app-level keys last month but did not rotate KMS key. They also say some rewraps happened on their side, but vague.
sec-oncall: Proposed containment: - Label key `suspected-exposed` in incident tracker - Add an alert on any Decrypts against that key - Temporarily restrict IAM roles to only partner and security/ops principals (deny others) - Coordinate with partner before revoking old versions (revocation will break decrypts)
aj: Note: GCP KMS key rotation creates versions; old ciphertext remains decryptable unless you disable older versions. Rewrapping requires decrypt+encrypt with new key/version; no server-side rewrap primitive exists in GCP KMS. We'll need cooperation from partner or plaintext access.
samir: I'm exporting a CSV of all matching GCS objects to `gs://sec-incidents/INC-4273-acme-blob-list.csv`.
deploy-bot: export job finished: 42 objects -> gs://sec-incidents/INC-4273-acme-blob-list.csv
len: Security will also enable permanent forwarding of KMS Data Access logs to sec-audit project with 90d retention if not already enabled.
rosa: Analytics note: We ran two decrypts for telemetry parsing. We do not persist plaintext; flow is decrypt -> extract headers -> discard plaintext. I'll still snapshot the small set of parsed outputs and freeze any derived tables until IR completes.
maria.s: Good. I'll open ticket INC-4273 and add owners: security=maria.s, ops=samir, infra=aj, analytics=rosa. I'll also draft partner comms requesting detailed rewrap timeline and whether any plaintext was exported.
sec-oncall: Runbook additions: - If any plaintext sinks are found (internal buckets, BigQuery tables), rotate affected app secrets immediately and record rotated secrets in ticket. - Offer partner a joint maintenance window to perform rewraps and rotate KMS keys; coordinate re-encryption strategy. - Post-incident: add per-key anomaly detection for decrypt volume spikes and document cross-tenant ciphertext exposure playbook.
aj: For Vault transit: run `vault read sys/mounts` and check the transit mount config for an external key id mapping. If found, update the mount to point to new key id after partner rotates.
samir: Action list I'm taking now: 1) full grep+export (done) 2) decrypt audit export (done) 3) add temp IAM deny for non-owner principals on `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner-keys` 4) coordinate with partner for rewrap plan.
maria.s: I'll hold off on key revocation until partner agrees to coordinated rotate. In the meantime, apply RBAC locks and detection. I'll update INC-4273 with the CSV and logging export.
len: Also schedule a 1-hour postmortem after containment: owners, timeline, gaps (audit retention, cross-tenant key visibility), and a remediation plan (automation for alerts + RBAC hardening).
sec-oncall: If partner reports plaintext in public buckets or evidence of exfil, escalate to P1 immediately. Otherwise keep as P2.
rosa: We'll provide a short writeup of our telemetry flow and confirm no plaintext persisted.
maria.s: Thanks team. Adding those notes and marking follow-ups. :lock:
